abjection.body.head: Head
abjection.medical.apply_hint: Click item, release, then left/right-click a body part
abjection.inventory.title: Medical inventory
abjection.procedure.title: Medical procedure
abjection.status.bleed_type.heading: Bleeding
abjection.procedure.cancel: Esc: leave; used material is not restored
abjection.procedure.guide.wrap: Grab the roll and wind clockwise. Multiple layers provide gradual bleed care. Keep winding; the percentage is remaining material.
abjection.procedure.guide.syringe: LMB: align and insert the needle. Hold RMB for the plunger, then withdraw straight.
abjection.procedure.guide.antiseptic: Hold the bottle at the marker. Aim the nozzle inside the box and right-click to spray.
abjection.procedure.guide.potion: LMB: bring the bottle to the wound. Mouse wheel: tilt; keep the pouring angle steady.
abjection.procedure.guide.splint_align: Align the splint with both marks. Mouse wheel: rotate. Release to fit.
abjection.procedure.guide.splint_straps: Thread each strap to the right, then pull it left to tension. Stay on the rail.
abjection.procedure.guide.tourniquet_fit: Place the tourniquet between the marks, then release.
abjection.procedure.guide.tourniquet_tig: Thread the strap to the right, then grasp the windlass and turn it clockwise three times.
abjection.thought.supply_space: Need room for the unused items.
abjection.hint.antibiotics: RMB: swallow. Controls infection; excess is toxic.
abjection.hint.painkillers: RMB: swallow. Relieves pain; overdose risk.
abjection.procedure.guide.tool: Drag the tool onto the marked game body region and hold steady. Esc cancels; completed extraction wears the tool once.
abjection.report.vitals: Blood %s%%; O2 %s%%; water %s%%; nutrition %s%%; body %s C; load %s%%; red cells %s%%; plasma %s%%
abjection.hint.naloxone: Use the medical panel. Blocks opioid effects.
abjection.hint.blood_bag: Use the medical panel. Replaces blood.
abjection.hint.saline: Use the medical panel. Replaces plasma.
abjection.hint.ice_pack: Apply to burns or bruises. Not for frostbite.
abjection.hint.chest_drain: Apply to the torso. Supports injured lung recovery.
abjection.status.remove_splint: / splint: remove with the right-side button
abjection.defib.not_needed: This device cannot be used on this patient.
abjection.defib.cu_aed_guide: LMB: drag the pads as their pictures show. Release both, wait for analysis, then press the lightning button.
abjection.defib.cu_manual_guide: LMB: turn the dial with your hand. The arrow button charges; the lightning button delivers the shock.
abjection.pause.denied: There is no time to stop. Hold on.
abjection.heal.done: Fully restored: injuries and conditions cleared.
abjection.afterlife.thought.0: Where do thoughts go when there is nobody left to think them?
abjection.afterlife.thought.1: Would anyone notice if I disappeared?
abjection.afterlife.thought.2: I wanted everything to go quiet.
abjection.afterlife.thought.3: I was tired of being here.
abjection.afterlife.thought.4: Why did I feel so alone, even with other people?
abjection.afterlife.thought.5: Is this all that will be left of me?
abjection.afterlife.thought.6: I did not know how to ask for help.
abjection.afterlife.thought.7: What if tomorrow could have been different?
abjection.hint.antidepressants: RMB: take. Gradually treats melancholic, psychotic, and persistent depression; excess is toxic.
abjection.hint.anxiolytic: RMB: take. Rapidly relieves acute panic and psychotic features; causes drowsiness.
abjection.hint.herbal_tea: RMB: drink. Hydrates, calms, and gently lifts mood.
abjection.thought.depression.situational: Everything feels overwhelming... I need somewhere safe.
abjection.thought.depression.seasonal: Too dark for too long... I miss the daylight.
abjection.thought.depression.melancholic: Nothing brings relief anymore... everything feels hollow.
abjection.thought.depression.psychotic: Shadows and whispers won't stop... I need to calm down.
abjection.thought.depression.persistent: This grey weight has lingered for far too long.
abjection.thought.ptsd.0: I still remember every single death...
abjection.thought.ptsd.1: That moment flashes back before my eyes... my heart is racing.
abjection.thought.ptsd.2: Death did not erase the memory. The terror is still here.
abjection.thought.ptsd.3: A new body, yet my mind remembers all the pain.
abjection.self_harm.title: Self-Harm
abjection.thought.self_harm.urge: Everything inside is screaming... my hand reaches for the blade.
abjection.thought.self_harm.after: The sharp pain in my skin briefly numbed the emptiness inside.
abjection.sleep.title: Sleep
abjection.sleep.too_awake: I am too wide awake to fall asleep right now.
